newsitem.title: USA: Conceptronic buys White Mountain Cable.
newsitem.headline: Conceptronic buys White Mountain Cable.

text.p: Conceptronic Inc Wednesday said it closed its acquisition of White Mountain Cable Construction Corp of Epsom, N.H., for about $17.2 million.
White Mountain Cable provides aerial construction and splicing services for both fiber optic and coaxial cable to telecommunications industry customers.

The purchase price is to be satisfied with a combination of cash and Conceptronic common stock, plus the assumption of outstanding debt. White Mountain Cable will operate as a wholly owned subsidiary of Conceptronic.
